title: An integral finitely presented algebra is finite
statement: Let A -> B be a homomorphism of commutative rings. If B is integral over A and finitely presented as an A-algebra (equivalently, B is generated by finitely many A-algebra generators with finitely many relations), then B is a finitely generated A-module.

source.place: Algebra Lemma Tag 02JJ (lemma-characterize-finite-in-terms-of-integral), together with Tag 0564 (lemma-finite-finitely-presented-extension): an integral algebra of finite type is finite, and finite presentation implies finite type
